Tells if a mouse is still plugged in. A mouse that was removed keeps its number, so a number never means a different mouse later on; one that is plugged in again gets its old number back.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Repeat
	Cls
	For i = 0 To MouseDeviceCount() - 1
		Text 10, 10 + i * 16, MouseDeviceName(i) + ": " + MouseDeviceConnected(i)
	Next
	Flip
Until KeyHit(1)
```
@param device  The mouse to ask, counted from 0 in the order they were seen.
@returns 1 if the mouse is connected, otherwise 0 (also for a number that no mouse has).
@gap This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the original has no such command.
